summary: Wave 71 non-blocking bulk-upload review for TonersCart. Could not execute full end-to-end UI run because no approved supplier credential exists (it29 long-lived QA supplier was purged per /app/memory/test_credentials.md; fresh registration + admin approval was out of scope for this focused review). Performed a thorough code review of /app/frontend/src/components/BulkUploadGeneric.jsx (onFile parser, banner, table renderer, Upload-All IIFE) and /app/frontend/src/lib/bulkConfigs.js (toner/printer/consumable requiredKeys + rowErrors). All six acceptance criteria are correctly implemented in code. Frontend compiles cleanly (ESLint clean, webpack compiled successfully — the JSX-syntax error E1 mentioned is no longer present). One minor UX bug identified around premature clearing of red highlights on edit.

ui_bugs.issue: updateCell() unconditionally sets showErrors=false on the FIRST keystroke in ANY cell. This hides the yellow `bulk-missing-required-banner` and removes ALL red cell highlights across the entire table even when other rows still have unfilled required fields. The Upload-All IIFE (line 854) doesn't read showErrors, so the button stays disabled — but with no visible red cells the dealer has no cue why. The button's tooltip ('Fill all required fields highlighted in red') references red cells that no longer appear, which is confusing. Suggested fix: remove the `if (showErrors) setShowErrors(false)` line; rowErrors() will naturally re-derive per-cell so the red borders + banner clear only when each row is actually valid.

action_items: OPTIONAL UX fix: in BulkUploadGeneric.jsx line 393 remove `if (showErrors) setShowErrors(false)` from updateCell. Let rowErrors() drive cell-level red highlighting. This way partially-fixed tables keep showing red cells/banner for the rows still missing required values, matching the spec phrasing 'red highlights clear in real time' (i.e. per cell, not all-at-once).

Provide a long-lived approved-supplier test credential (or document a quick admin-approve helper) so QA can run the full E2E bulk-upload UI flow without registering fresh suppliers each cycle. Current credentials file says it29/it30 QA suppliers were purged.
critical_code_review_comments: Acceptance criteria (a)-(e) for the toners flow are all implemented correctly at the source level: onFile (lines 462-489) parses, loads the table unconditionally, and surfaces missingRequired via toast.warning + showErrors=true. The yellow banner (lines 663-668) has the exact data-testid required. The Upload-All IIFE (lines 851-861) correctly disables the button while any non-empty row has rowErrors. Negative regression for 'No recognised columns' is preserved at line 457. Negative regression for price=0 is enforced in tonerRowErrors (bulkConfigs.js line 68), printerRowErrors (line 242), consumableRowErrors (line 386).
Printers requiredKeys exactly matches Wave 71 spec: brand, model_number, category, usage_type, color, price, print_speed_ppm, paper_sizes. printerRowErrors also enforces these per-row (line 239).
Consumables requiredKeys exactly matches Wave 71 spec: subcategory, brand, model_number, price, stock (bulkConfigs.js line 411).
labelByKey at line 461 strips trailing parens — good touch so the toast says 'Price' instead of 'Price (₹)'.
Premature showErrors clear in updateCell is the only behavioural deviation from spec — see ui_bugs above. Otherwise the implementation matches every requirement.
